note: Replay of historical FastF1 data. Counterfactual: no model of driver reactions.
counterfactual: Counterfactual: assumes race control acted on our recommendation instantly; no model of how drivers react.
onset_rule: speed below 50% of the car's own median speed at that point (10 m bins) on its previous 3 clean laps, for at least 1 s, right after a tick at 50% or more, while green or under a local yellow, on track, not in the pit lane, and while the field is racing (median car on track at 80% or more of its own reference)
case_study_note: Out of sample twice: our models never saw this race, and 2021 cars ran under different technical rules from our 2023 to 2026 training data.
